title: A New Heaven and a New Earth
reflectionQuestion: God promised to come close and wipe away every tear with his very own hand. What is something happy you hope to do in that beautiful new place?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Heaven/Revelation). Closes the batch on resurrection HOPE + wonder (the_cross 1821 + empty_tomb 1812 already done; this is the unwritten hope anchor). Revelation 21's 'no more death/mourning/crying/pain' is framed entirely as COMFORT and promise -- the focus is God wiping away every tear and making everything new, never dwelling on death. Flag references_loss_softened. Tagged 'sad' so a grieving / missing-someone child can route to this comfort. Indelible image = God reaching out with his own hand to wipe away every tear. 'God' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_JOHN_BELOVED -- John is the author of Revelation; tender/loving register fits the new-creation hope. Bedtime-test strong: gentle, wonder-filled, replayable.
